The *Piṭṭhiduka, Hetuduka* (Patthana 12.13) is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* section of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Structurally, the text treats the conditional relations generated through the pairing of the supplementary dyads (*piṭṭhiduka*) with the root condition dyad (*hetuduka*) [SuttaCentral]. No dedicated English title is listed for this section in standard catalog records [SuttaCentral].
